I think there are a couple of basic questions need answered before we can find a good solution: 1) What are you trying to do? 2) What's your budget? Generically saying, "run inference" is like... you can do that on your current thinkpad, if you want a small enough model. If you want to run 7B or 13B or 34B models for document or sentiment analysis, or whatever, then you can move to the budget question. When I was faced with this question, I bought the cheapest 4060 Ti with 16GB I could find. It does "okay". Here's an example run:     Llama.generate: prefix-match hit
